action_items.detail: There is no 'Saltar animación' control anywhere in the codebase (grep found only 'Saltar al contenido principal'). I tested the /servicios chapter tabs instead: they scroll to their section (scrollY 500).

In /admin/contenido/page_faq at 1280x720, the sticky revision-history <aside> (ul.max-h-72) covers the first item's 'Eliminar' button, so a normal click times out. The check clicks it with a DOM click instead. Users may have to scroll before they can delete.

The fixed header hides on scroll-down. After a wizard step change, the step heading sits about 41-54px from the top, where the header would be if it were showing. On screenshots the heading is fully visible.

The FAQ CMS check published the unchanged original first, which added revisions as a baseline. It then restored that revision and published it. The published FAQ data now matches the original six items (verified in Mongo, hasUnpublished=false). The admin revision history has extra tscheck revisions (v2-v9).
